documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for For Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Both Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company Along With The Limited Review Report For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the INR 1,000 Crore revenue milestone with a significant increase in profitability and return metrics. The company benefited from strategic capacity expansions, notably the commercial commissioning of its new Alu-Zinc coating line and the augmentation of its existing colour-coated line. Management highlighted strong operating leverage, improved capital efficiency, and a debt-light balance sheet with no long-term debt. Looking ahead, the company targets consolidated revenues of INR 1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27 and plans further investments in backward integration, including a new cold-rolling mill targeting completion by December 2027. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting revenue of H584.18 Crore and a sales volume increase of 15% over the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that higher household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings, and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
demand_outlook.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested H85 Crore in a new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 110,800 TPA, funded through internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year. This investment of H85 Crore was funded through internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line to enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax increased by 226.24% from INR 11.70 Crore in FY 2024-25 to INR 38.17 Crore in FY 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 226.24% from H11.70 Crore in FY 2024-25 to H38.17 Crore, representing an incremental growth of H26.47 Crore.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 from 7.61% in FY 2023-24.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the global economic environment remains fragile and led to weakened demand and lower price realizations in the steel sector.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme involving the colour coating manufacturing line is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to introduce a new product, Alu-Zinc, during the year.
management_commitments.quote: The management is excited to introduce a new product, Alu-Zinc, an alloy consisting of 55% Aluminium and 45% Zinc on cold rolled strip, during the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
